generic_domain.justification: Surrogate modeling is a broader concept that includes the creation and use of various types of surrogates, such as local surrogate models. While 'local surrogate models' refers specifically to a type of model applied in localized contexts, 'surrogate modeling' encompasses all aspects of developing these approximate models, including their application across different scenarios. Therefore, surrogate modeling serves as the most comprehensive category that covers and includes local surrogate models within its scope.
